title: Leica Zeno FLX100 Plus GNSS Smart Antenna
summary:
The Zeno FLX100 Plus is a compact multi-frequency GNSS smart antenna for GIS and field data collection, and it has no fixed working distance: put it on a pole for survey-grade accuracy, carry it in a handheld tray, or pair it with your own phone or tablet.

184 channels across GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, and SBAS, RTK at 2 cm + 1 ppm horizontally, unlimited tilt compensation, and an update rate up to 10 Hz. It is IP67 and weighs 319 grams, so it is genuinely a carry-it instrument rather than a set-up-on-a-tripod one.

It works with Leica Zeno Mobile on Android, iOS, and Windows, and syncs to Esri ArcGIS Online, which makes it a natural fit for asset inventories and utility data capture.
specs: 184 channels, multi-constellation multi-frequency (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, SBAS)
RTK: H 2 cm + 1 ppm / V 3 cm + 1 ppm; static vertical 3 cm + 1 ppm
Tilt compensation unlimited, additional H uncertainty under 1.8 cm down to 30 degrees tilt
Bluetooth 5.0; internal battery 3.8 V / 6120 mAh, over 20 h operation, 4 h to full charge
319 g, 139 x 80.6 x 31 mm, IP67; storage -40 to +80 degrees C
Works with Leica Zeno Mobile on Android 12, iOS, and Windows; Esri ArcGIS Online synchronisation
accessories: Handheld pole mount and carry tray
